title: Evidence capture dirty context stays reviewable
description: Protects intended, unrelated, and unknown changed-file reporting plus command proof provenance in krn evidence capture.

cases.title: intended and unrelated dirty files are separated

input.gitStatus: package cwd paths plus root-parent report directory and unrelated raw material

expectedBehavior.subject: evidence_capture:dirty_context_classification
expectedBehavior.rationale: Evidence capture must make intended and unrelated dirty files visible so review burden is explicit.

protectedFailureModes.title: dirty context is collapsed into a flat changed-file list
protectedFailureModes.mustNot: Evidence capture must not mix intended files, unrelated dirty files, and command proof into an undifferentiated output.
protectedFailureModes.detection: CLI output omits intended/unrelated/unknown groups or fails to warn when unrelated dirty files are present.

cases.title: missing intended files keeps changes unknown and default proof weak

input.gitStatus: package cwd changed file without intended-file input

expectedBehavior.subject: evidence_capture:unknown_and_weak_default_proof
expectedBehavior.rationale: When no intended files or verification outcomes are supplied, changed files must remain unclassified and default command rows must stay weak proof.

protectedFailureModes.title: unknown files or weak default proof are hidden
protectedFailureModes.mustNot: Evidence capture must not treat unclassified changed files as intended or default_template command rows as command proof.
protectedFailureModes.detection: CLI output omits unknown classification or omits the weak default_template provenance warning.

cases.title: target evidence is rendered separately from KRN changed files

input.command: krn evidence capture --target-repo ../wilq-seo --target-mode observation-only --target-dirty-before dirty --target-dirty-after dirty --target-owned-changes external --target-changed-file "M apps/dashboard/src/App.tsx" --target-command "wilq-seo scripts/test.sh" --verification "wilq-seo scripts/test.sh=failed"
input.gitStatus: clean KRN repo with dirty target evidence supplied explicitly

expectedBehavior.subject: evidence_capture:target_evidence_boundary
expectedBehavior.rationale: Target repo proof must remain visible as target evidence, not be collapsed into KRN changed files or command strings.

protectedFailureModes.title: target dirty state disappears from evidence capture output
protectedFailureModes.mustNot: Evidence capture must not hide target repo mode, dirty state, ownership, target changed files, target commands, or target does-not-prove boundaries.
protectedFailureModes.detection: CLI output omits target evidence fields or treats target changed files as KRN repo changed files.

cases.title: retained pattern usefulness remains tied to evidence refs

input.command: krn evidence capture --intended-file packages/cli/src/runEvidenceCaptureCommand.ts --verification "pnpm typecheck=passed" --pattern-usefulness "pattern:ts-boundary-unknown-first-result-state=helped|Pattern selected the unknown-first parser shape|packages/cli/src/runEvidenceCaptureCommand.ts|Does not prove future pattern recall quality"
input.gitStatus: package cwd changed implementation file with explicit pattern usefulness feedback

expectedBehavior.subject: evidence_capture:pattern_usefulness_evidence_ref
expectedBehavior.rationale: Retained pattern usefulness must remain reviewable as evidence-backed feedback, not an automatic learning claim.

protectedFailureModes.title: pattern usefulness is recorded without evidence refs or non-proof boundary
protectedFailureModes.mustNot: Evidence capture must not render retained pattern usefulness as helped feedback unless the pattern id, evidence ref, reason, and does-not-prove boundary are visible.
protectedFailureModes.detection: CLI output omits patternUsefulnessOutcomes, the retained pattern id, evidenceRef, or doesNotProve.
